title: Robotic Surgery Doubled Before Most Patients Noticed
hook: Robotic procedures rose 98% while surgery still looked traditional.
closing: Robots moved from operating-room novelty toward routine care patients increasingly encounter.
question: Would you trust robotic surgery?

segments.say: Robotic procedures rose 98 percent, turning a specialized tool into mainstream surgery.
Robots handled 15.1 percent of general surgeries, showing the method was no longer rare.
Robotic-surgery revenue reached 7.1 billion dollars, reflecting how quickly hospitals adopted the technology.
